text:
jamal: planning a late-night cutover for eu-prod at 01:00 UTC. this will flip traffic to the new routing shim. need freeze lifted and an on-call handoff at 00:30. @maria @laura

maria: I can take 00:30-02:00. request we pin model/service to rwinf-v3.2.1 for the cutover — rwinf-v3.2.0 showed that memory leak under sustained load.

laura: +1 on pin. ops question: can we get a deploy-bot dry-run and a quick canary smoke? adding @deploy-bot to run preflight.

deploy-bot: scheduled dry-run triggered by laura at 2024-11-14T23:10:00Z
preflight results: all services green except cache-warmup (warning). See run: https://ci.internal/runs/98765
Commands to be executed in cutover:
```
./infra/deploy --env eu-prod --pin rwinf-v3.2.1 --steps preflight,canary,cutover
```

jamal: cache-warmup warning noted. plan: increase KV cache TTL by 10m during canary window to smooth traffic. laura — please prepare rollback playbook and place in #incidents.

laura: rollback playbook (draft):
- revoke traffic: `routectl deny eu-prod --release rwinf-v3.2.1`
- pin back: `infra pin rwinf-v3.2.0`
- scale-down (if needed): `kubectl scale deployment api --replicas=0 --namespace eu-prod`
- notify: escalate to #incidents and call on-call
I'll drop this into the release notes and /incidents doc.

maria: quick perf check: latency P95 on rwinf-v3.2.1 canary was 120ms vs baseline ~95ms. acceptable for cutover?

jamal: prefer under 150ms during the cutover. set observability alert thresholds to 200ms P95 and error rate 1% so we have an automated trigger.

laura: set alert command: `obsctl create --svc rwinf --env eu-prod --p95 200ms --err 1% --notify #eng-oncall`

deploy-bot: change window lock: freeze starts 00:00 UTC and ends 03:00 UTC. freeze exceptions require approval from jamal + eng-sre. Pin applied: rwinf-v3.2.1.

maria: approved (freeze exception if needed). jamal: approved. I'll update release notes and post the canary checklist.

jamal: final preflight checklist for 01:00 cutover:
- pins set ✅
- rollback playbook in #incidents ✅
- canary pods pre-warmed ✅
- obs thresholds set ✅
- comms channel locked to eng-releases + eng-oncall ✅
Go at 00:55 for smoke, cut at 01:00. :rocket:

laura: I'll be on-call during the cut. ping me if error rate > 0.5% or latency exceeds thresholds.

maria: posting release notes snippet:
"Release rwinf-v3.2.1: routing shim fixes and memory leak mitigation. Canary at 01:00 UTC (EU). Rollback target: rwinf-v3.2.0."

jamal: thanks team. emergency rollback flow = follow laura's steps + open #incidents and @eng-oncall. otherwise proceed on the planned cadence.
